_note: The client's three ACTUAL products, extracted from the brief's reference photos. Real-world dimensions are DOCUMENTED ASSUMPTIONS used purely as scale anchors for the compositor (see design.md 'Scale estimation'). They are deliberately conservative, typical commercial-planter sizes; swap for the client's real spec sheet when available.

products.name: Charcoal Cylinder
products.planting: lush mixed foliage – hosta, fatsia japonica, ornamental grasses, trailing greens
products.palette: deep greens, no strong flower colour
products.best_for: framing one side of a doorway; narrow pavements; modern dark shopfronts
products.scale_notes: Rim sits at roughly knee-to-mid-thigh height on an adult (~75cm). Foliage adds ~50cm above the rim.

products.name: Corten Tiered Set
products.form: modular weathered-steel set – one tall cube, one stepped lower cube, optional long trough
products.planting: architectural palm underplanted with ferns and red/pink seasonal flowers
products.palette: rust planter + green palm + hot red/pink flowers
products.best_for: wider frontages and corners; statement entrances; warm brick or stone buildings; where a tall vertical accent (palm ~2m overall) suits the facade
products.scale_notes: Tall cube reaches ~waist/elbow height (~100cm); palm crown reaches ~2m total. Needs clear pavement width – do not place where it blocks the door swing or pedestrian flow.

products.name: White Tapered Pair
products.planting: mixed greenery with purple and pink flowering stems
products.best_for: lighter / painted shopfronts and salons; where a bright planter lifts a dark or muted facade; flanking a doorway as a pair
products.scale_notes: Rim at roughly mid-thigh (~70cm); planting adds ~40cm. Tapered form reads smaller at the base – keep both of the pair at matching scale.
